messages:
maya: Quick design sync: proposing a "compactness" control for the Roles matrix (0-100 slider) so org admins can choose density per their preference. Also thinking about how to surface SSO in the invite drawer without modal interrupts. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc (Frames: Roles-compact, Invite-hint).

julien: Love the slider idea for experiments. Suggest defaults: 70 for orgs with lots of roles, 40 for new orgs. When density > 80 show a small banner: 'Reduced spacing enabled'.

alex: Accessibility concern: slider states must have labels and keyboard arrows should move by 5 units. Also when density changes we need smooth layout shift or users will lose context. Consider animating height changes with prefers-reduced-motion check.

katie: For invite SSO: instead of a banner, try an inline pill next to each invitee's email that reads "SSO enforced" (yellow outline) with a question-mark tooltip. That avoids breaking the flow and makes it clear per-invitee. Copy: "SSO enforced: users sign in via your organization's identity provider."

maya: The per-email pill is neat. But if the org recently turned SSO on/off, invites in-flight could be ambiguous. Need server validation at send and a realtime toast if policy changed.

julien: Implementation detail: show pill client-side if org.sso_enforced === true from the settings API. On send, call POST /orgs/:id/invites which returns 409 + reason if policy changed since fetch. Show inline error on the email row.

alex: A11y for the pill: use role="status"? Better: add aria-describedby pointing to hidden text that explains the implications. Tooltip content should be accessible via keyboard and persistent in DOM (not just on hover).

katie: Copy tweak: prefer "Enforce" over "Require"; "Require" reads harsh. Proposed microcopy: "Enforce Single Sign-On for new members — they'll sign in with your identity provider." Tooltip: "SSO affects how users authenticate and how deprovisioning works. Learn more." Link to docs.open.redwood.com/sso.

maya: Good. Back to the Roles matrix: when compactness slider is > 60, collapse permission descriptions to icons with accessible alt text, but keep hover card that expands to full text on focus/hover. Julien, can you produce a hover card spec?

julien: I'll add hover/focus card with header (role name), body (short list of top 3 permissions), and a "view full permissions" link. Card must accept keyboard focus and close on Esc. Will add focus trap? No trap, just a dismissible panel.

alex: For keyboarding through rows we should ensure tab order is predictable: Role cell -> tools -> overflow menu -> next row. If a hover card opens, it should be reachable by Enter or Space, not only hover. Add aria-expanded on the role label.

katie: Minor UI ask: role chips should support color-blind safe palettes. Use patterns not just color (small left bar + color). Also test in high-contrast mode.

maya: Audit log nav: idea is a lightweight left rail when viewport >= 1024px that groups filters (actor, action, resource, date). On mobile use a modal filter panel. Persist filters in URL to enable shareable links. Thoughts?

julien: I like left rail grouped filters. Add a "Save filter" feature so admins can bookmark common queries. Could store presets per-org.

alex: UX for back button: storing filters in URL solves the lost-state issue. Also add a small 'return to list' breadcrumb inside event detail that restores scroll position. Use sessionStorage to keep scroll offset keyed by filter query.

katie: Accessibility: ensure the left rail has aria-label="Audit filters" and each filter group is a landmark (role="region" aria-labelledby). Provide a keyboard shortcut `f` to focus filters.

maya: Good call. Also for events, show timezone preference and allow toggle: 'Show times in: Org timezone / Local'. Default to user's last setting. Add hover to show ISO timestamp for debugging.

julien: Logging requirement: include `event_trace_id` and `inviter_id` metadata in the event payload for correlation. Devs can use the copy icon next to each event to copy full JSON.

alex: Small perf note: the Roles matrix should lazy-render rows below the fold and use virtualized list when count > 200. Also batch permission badge loads to avoid n+1.

katie: Usability test plan: run 6 participants (3 admins heavy role users, 3 new orgs) with A/B: compact slider default ON vs default OFF. Measure time to find a specific role and success rate for inviting a user with SSO.

maya: Action items: Julien -> add hover card + filter-rail comps; Alex -> a11y checklist (slider labels, pill aria-describedby, focus order, reduced-motion), and check virtualization plan; Katie -> final microcopy + test plan; Maya -> write PR template snippet for server 409 handling and sessionStorage scroll restore.

ux-bot: scheduling: added "Roles compactness usability" to UX research calendar Thu. :calendar:

julien: I'll update Figma and ping for a quick sync when done.

maya: Thanks team, leaning to ship compactness toggle behind feature flag for initial rollout. Closing thread for now.
